name: Morishita
tagline: Two lines, a wide set of no-transfer destinations, and modest rent.
summary: Morishita is where the Toei Shinjuku and Oedo lines cross, giving direct rides to both Shinjuku and Roppongi, with Otemachi 15 minutes away. It is an old-Tokyo part of Koto Ward, and rent is well below stations inside the Yamanote loop with the same commute time.
goodFor: People whose commute might change direction
People balancing central access against rent
People who like a low-key, traditional neighborhood
notFor: People who want a wide choice of shops and restaurants
People who care about neighborhood style
People who want to board at a terminus
residentComment: Having two lines here counts for a lot. Nothing flashy, but the rent is clearly low for the access you get — and Kiyosumi-Shirakawa and Monzen-Nakacho are both walkable when you want more going on.
